## Feature Description
A clear description of the economic model or simulation feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case
Why is this feature valuable for AFI economic research?

## Proposed Approach
How might this be implemented? (Optional)

## Example Config/Output
What would the config look like? What outputs would it generate? (Optional)

## Boundary Check
- [ ] This feature is research/simulation-only (no DAG/engine/contract/UI code)
- [ ] This feature uses placeholder/toy formulas (or integrates with afi-math)
